subject: Hosted API billing export and commit-tier proposal
messages:
From: Emma Larson <emma@findash.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: billing export + commit tiers for Hosted API

Hi Jonas,

We’re evaluating Redwood for a hosted API rollout and need two things to progress with procurement:

1) A token-level usage export for the past quarter (daily granularity) broken out by model, route (chat/generate/embeddings), and token type (input/output). I attached our internal sample output for reference (FinDash_usage_q3_tokens.csv).

2) Clear pricing options for committed volumes vs pay-as-you-go. Our engineering forecast is ~1B tokens/mo at peak; procurement wants to see the slab pricing, any step discounts, and whether discounts can be applied pro-rated if a commit starts mid-billing-cycle.

Also, our finance team needs the proposed invoice line-item structure (GL mapping) so they can map to our bookkeeping. Can you confirm format and attachment capabilities (CSV/S3/GCS)?

If helpful, I can share expected month-by-month ramp. We want to close by the end of October.

Thanks,
Emma Larson
Head of Platform
FinDash Inc
emma@findash.com

Attachment: FinDash_usage_q3_tokens.csv (CSV, 12 KB)

From: jonas_weber@redwood.com
To: Emma Larson <emma@findash.com>
Date: 2026-10-19T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: billing export + commit tiers for Hosted API

Hi Emma — thanks for the details and the sample. Quick answers up front, then next steps below.

Summary of commit options (high level):
- Pay-as-you-go (no commit): standard per-token rates, billed monthly.
- Commit Silver: 250M tokens/month, 7% discount off standard per-token rates.
- Commit Gold: 1B tokens/month, 12% discount.
- Enterprise Custom: >1B tokens/month, negotiated slab with volume tiers and optional prepay discounts.

On pro-rating: we can apply the agreed commit discount for the billing period pro-rated from the commit activation date. If you want retroactive application to the start of a billing cycle, that's something we can consider on a case-by-case basis (usually requires written approval).

Billing export capabilities:
- We deliver daily CSV exports with these columns: date, model, route, request_id (if requested), tokens_input, tokens_output, total_tokens, customer_rate_code, invoice_line_key.
- Exports can be delivered to S3/GCS or as downloadable CSV via the Console.
- We can include request-level metadata for up to 90 days in the export; for longer retention we offer an add-on.

I attached a sample itemized invoice CSV and a short proposed commit terms summary to show formats.

Next steps I recommend:
1) Confirm preferred commit tier (or target discount).
2) Tell me whether S3 delivery is OK for exports and the bucket details (we can also push to your secure file transfer).
3) If procurement needs an approved concession (retroactive discount/PO terms), I’ll loop in my manager, Marissa, to approve.

I’ll cc Marissa and Ava (our billing lead) so procurement questions are covered.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.com

Attachments: proposed_commit_terms.pdf (PDF, 18 KB); sample_invoice_itemized.csv (CSV, 8 KB)

From: Emma Larson <emma@findash.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-19T13:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: billing export + commit tiers for Hosted API

Jonas — thanks, this is helpful. A few clarifications from procurement and finance:

- For the export we need daily granularity and the request-level request_id column for reconciliation. The CSV schema you outlined is fine.
- Procurement wants to know if discounts can be backdated to the start of a calendar month if we sign mid-month — they prefer not to lose that partial-month discount.
- Finance asks that invoice_line_key map to three GL codes we’ll provide; can you include an extra column in the export with our GL mapping?

We can target Commit Gold (1B tokens/mo) but need confirmation on the effective discount if we do a 12-month prepay vs monthly commit. Also, curious if you offer a blended rate for the first 90 days while we ramp.

On Tue, Oct 19, 2026 at 11:04 AM jonas_weber@redwood.com wrote:
> Billing export capabilities:
> - We deliver daily CSV exports with these columns: date, model, route, request_id (if requested), tokens_input, tokens_output, total_tokens, customer_rate_code, invoice_line_key.
> - Exports can be delivered to S3/GCS or as downloadable CSV via the Console.

Thanks — attaching procurement’s short GL mapping and our expected ramp by month. Can you propose final terms by Wed?

Emma

Cc: procurement@findash.com
Attachment: FinDash_GL_mapping.xlsx (XLSX, 6 KB)

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: Emma Larson <emma@findash.com>, jonas_weber@redwood.com
Cc: ava_chen@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-20T09:35:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: billing export + commit tiers for Hosted API

Hi Emma — looping in officially from Sales Ops. I reviewed the ask and here’s what we can commit to for FD-2026-089: 

1) Pricing concession: Commit Gold (1B tokens/mo) at 10% off standard per-token for the first 3 months to support ramp. If you prepay 12 months up front we’ll add an additional 2% (total 12% for months covered by prepay).

2) Pro-rating: We will apply the agreed commit discount pro-rated from the activation date. We can also approve retroactive application to the beginning of the billing month for this deal; procurement should confirm the PO date.

3) Billing export & invoice line items: We will deliver daily CSV exports to your S3 bucket using the schema Jonas outlined. The invoice will include explicit line items for:
   - model_usage (per-model tokens)
   - embeddings_usage
   - storage/backing-store fees (if applicable)
   - overage charges (per-token over committed slab)

We will add an optional column customer_GL_code so your finance team can import directly into the ledger. Sample export and sample invoice line-item CSV are attached.

4) Paperwork: We will create a DocuSign for the Commit Gold agreement (deal FD-2026-089). I’ve attached the draft terms; once signed we’ll provision S3 export access and apply the discount as described.

Jonas — action items for us: prepare the signed agreement (DocuSign) and a one-page summary for procurement with billing/export examples. Ava — please validate the S3 delivery flow and retention default (90 days request-level metadata; option to extend).

Emma — please confirm you accept the concession and I’ll escalate to legal for a quick DocuSign.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Director, Sales Ops
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Attachments: sample_invoice_itemized.csv (CSV, 8 KB); docsign_draft_FD-2026-089.pdf (PDF, 22 KB)

From: Emma Larson <emma@findash.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@findash.com
Date: 2026-10-21T16:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: billing export + commit tiers for Hosted API

Marissa / Jonas — thanks, we accept the Commit Gold concession as outlined (10% for first 3 months, additional 2% for annual prepay). Please send the DocuSign and the PO instructions.

Two requests before signature:
1) Include a one-line note in the DocuSign that the discount may be applied retroactively to the start of the billing month if the PO is dated within that month.
2) Confirm S3 delivery details and any IAM role you’ll create so our cloud team can whitelist.

If those are included, procurement will route the PO immediately. Appreciate the quick turnaround — looking forward to getting started.

Emma Larson
Head of Platform, FinDash
emma@findash.com

Cc: procurement@findash.com
